d:
A video from Virangana Lakshmibai Jhansi (VGLJ) Railway Station has sparked controversy after a woman TTE was heard insulting and threatening passengers during an argument over tickets. She allegedly called a passenger “illiterate” and said she hated his face. Following the viral video, Railways suspended the TTE and initiated a departmental inquiry. Other railway staff have also been counselled on courteous behaviour.
